scenario_description:
Objective: Reduce the chance of a mirror-scan error during Devin Holt's next articulated-bus assignment while his qualification remains active.
Emerging Need: Separate training observations reveal the same unprompted scan omission before an upcoming service run, although neither exercise caused an incident.
Decision Context: Internal guidance and the qualification record distinguish preventive coaching from certification action; a short instructor opening later makes coaching feasible without changing dispatch or employment status.
Consequence: Coaching completed before pull-out could reduce risk during the run; once service begins, that preventive benefit is unavailable even though no collision, injury, or damage has occurred.

parameter.subject: Observation note - Devin Holt yard drill
parameter.body: During this morning's articulated-bus lane-positioning drill, Devin Holt (employee EMP-447) omitted the right-side mirror rescan before beginning a lateral move. I prompted the rescan, and he completed the exercise normally. There was no contact, injury, or equipment damage. This note records only today's training observation.

parameter.body: A cancellation has opened one no-cost 30-minute AB-7 defensive-scan coaching slot today from 15:30 to 16:00 in South Depot Simulator 2. I am the designated instructor.
